name: EPIC 211375606
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 13.7 solar radii and 1.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211375606 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.723391 (16th-84th percentiles 12.929843-14.578577), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211375606 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.145241 (16th-84th percentiles 1.001521-1.311409), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211375606: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4633.4985 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211375606 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 6185.078125 (16th-84th percentiles 5912.265625-6472.8125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.19 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 6,185 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.15 solar masses and 13.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,633 K at its surface.
